data.name: Anjay
data.gender_notes: Anjay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anjay is a Sanskrit name, derived from the term 'Anj' which means 'An' (without) and 'Jay' (victory). This name signifies the one who attains victory without any effort, through God's grace. The name Anjay carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anjay usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anjay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anjay total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

The name signifies the one who conquers adversities and obstacles with ease and grace. This name also signifies the belief in the power of divine intervention and the support of the gods in one's life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Anjay holds immense significance. It is a reminder that true victory comes not from our own efforts alone, but through the grace and blessings of God. The name encourages us to have faith in the divine and surrender to its will, knowing that success and fulfillment will come in due time.
